subject: Scrape.ly is listed on PickAPlugin
text:
Hi,

I run PickAPlugin, a free directory of Codex and ChatGPT plugins. Scrape.ly got picked up this week and now has its own page: https://pickaplugin.com/p/scrape-ly

If you want, there's a free README badge that links back to it (https://pickaplugin.com/badge). And if you ever update your best MCP servers post, a mention of the directory as a place to find more Codex plugins would be great. No pressure either way, and tell me if anything on the listing is wrong.

Thanks,
Aaron, PickAPlugin

subject: Your MCP servers ranking + a data source
text:
Hi,

Really like that every line on your MCP servers ranking has a source. I run PickAPlugin, a free directory of Codex and ChatGPT plugins, and we put together some original numbers on the Codex plugin side: https://pickaplugin.com/research/state-of-codex-plugins-2026

It's free to cite with a credit link if it's ever useful for an article. Happy to link to AgentShortlist from our guides too if you think a swap makes sense.

Aaron, PickAPlugin

subject: One more route for your MCP submission checklist
text:
Hi,

Your where to submit an MCP server checklist is one of the clearer ones out there, especially the registry vs directory split.

One route you might add: PickAPlugin (https://pickaplugin.com), a free directory for Codex and ChatGPT plugins. Listing is free and there's no backlink required, makers just submit at https://pickaplugin.com/submit. Would you consider adding it to the community directories section?

Thanks,
Aaron, PickAPlugin
